annotations.text:
DOOMCRAFT SITE — four screens, one vocabulary (the live landing page + progress board tokens).
Homepage: animated hero (voxel build-in, ember, muzzle-flash pulse, scanline, ticker), one primary action repeated, modes, proof, what's-new fed from the release feed, a sponsor band, community.
Sign in: name + passphrase (the real auth), device progress claimed on sign-in, guest path kept. Social sign-in shown as 'soon'.
Sponsors: the phase-one surfaces and the measurement promise from docs/SPONSORS.md, an apply form.
[BRACKETS] are real facts we do not have yet — live count, rate card, contact email, build id, news items. Fill them; do not let them ship.

Motion is CSS only (the site has no script budget and the game's CSP is strict). The 'motion' tweak on the homepage switches it all off; prefers-reduced-motion does too. Play button throb is the one repeating beat; everything else plays once on load.
